svg.title: Masked spectral autoencoder training pipeline
svg.desc: Full figure inventory: a left Input card contains a waveform, OR label, and spectrogram; data flows through Encoder, DFT, Latent Spec., user/random mask arrows, Masked Spec., DFT-1, Decoder, and a right Variation card containing waveform, OR, spectrogram. Red dashed feedback paths show Add Noise and Reconstruction Loss. Blue dotted paths show masking/variation cues. The layout is horizontally symmetric around the paired spectrum boxes and keeps dashed feedback along the lower band.

g.desc: Inside f01: title at top, waveform centered in upper half, OR separator, and a lower spectrogram panel. Objects are vertically stacked and centered.
Inside f04: a compact sloping multicolor latent spectrum plot occupies the upper panel, with label below.
Between f04 and f06: blue dotted user mask arrow is above the red dashed random mask arrow; both point from latent spectrum toward masked spectrum. The section uses two parallel horizontal lanes.
Inside f06: a black step-like mask curve spans the plot area; colored spectral remnants appear in two separated windows. Label sits at bottom.
A blue dotted curved cue above the decoder asks for variation and then points into the right output card.
Inside f09: title, upper waveform, OR label, and lower spectrogram mirror the left input card, expressing a generated variation.

Lower feedback section: Add Noise is a dashed red path from the input side toward the decoder input; Reconstruction Loss is a longer dashed red path from the variation side back to the input side. Both use orthogonal segments matching the original.
